A is the correct distribution. Kathy takes the condominium by survivorship under the delivered tenancy-by-the-entirety deed, a completed lifetime gift the prenuptial waiver does not undo, so Julie’s devise is adeemed. The prenup waives pretermitted-spouse, elective-share, and similar marital claims, so Tommy takes the pasture under the will and Tommy and Julie split the residue.

CONFIDENCE: 84
